Feature: Added 'My Mods' feature that lets users save ingredient preferences (e.g. add tomatoes / skip sour cream) and apply them to any order with a single tap.
Source: QSR Magazine; NRN; Taco Bell newsroom — announced Aug 5, 2026
Notes: Over 50% of TB orders include a customization; this directly reduces ordering friction for repeat customizers. Strong signal for BK given BK's own customization volume.

Feature: Added 'My Menu' section that saves favorite orders and surfaces personalized recommendations to make future ordering faster.
Source: QSR Magazine; NRN; Taco Bell newsroom — announced Aug 5, 2026
Notes: Pairs with My Mods as a unified personalization layer. Recommendations are algorithmic based on past orders.

Feature: Redesigned loyalty hub with a dedicated 'Tuesday Drops' section for easy one-tap access to weekly exclusive deals.
Source: QSR Magazine; NRN; Taco Bell newsroom — announced Aug 5, 2026
Notes: Makes weekly cadence a design element, not just a promo mechanic. Creates habitual re-engagement hook.

Feature: Redesigned loyalty hub consolidates points balance and full order history into a single screen.
Source: QSR Magazine; NRN; Taco Bell newsroom — announced Aug 5, 2026
Notes: Positions loyalty as a tracking tool not just a discount mechanism.

Feature: Announced upcoming lock screen order tracking widget for iOS/Android (not yet live in app).
Source: NRN; QSR Magazine — announced Aug 5, 2026; not confirmed live in app
Notes: Announced alongside August redesign but listed as 'upcoming.' Also announced: group ordering function and updated search/discovery.

Feature: Launched three-tier loyalty structure (Green / Gold / Reserve) on March 10 with differentiated star-earning rates (1.0 / 1.2 / 1.7 stars per $1) and tier-exclusive benefits.
Source: Official Starbucks newsroom; Fast Company; Newsweek; Customer Experience Dive — launched March 10, 2026
Notes: Top 5% auto-assigned to Reserve, next 20% to Gold. Green stars expire in 6 months; Gold/Reserve stars never expire. Received significant backlash from longtime members on social media.

Feature: Added a new 60-star redemption tier that gives members $2 off any item.
Source: Official Starbucks newsroom; Axios — launched March 10, 2026
Notes: New lower-cost redemption option below the existing tiers. Lowers the barrier to first redemption.

Feature: Launched 'Free Mod Mondays' — all members get one free drink modification on the first Monday of each month.
Source: Official Starbucks newsroom; Loyalty & Reward Co — launched March 2026
Notes: Available to all tiers including Green. Designed to drive monthly engagement. Creates a predictable content/promotion cadence visible in the app.

Feature: Expanding 'Ready on Arrival' geofencing system that detects when a mobile-order customer is within ~3 minutes of the restaurant and starts preparing their order automatically.
Source: Restaurant Dive; Customer Experience Dive; Grocery Gazette (Aug 26 2026); Chain Store Age
Notes: Aims to cut wait times by half. Tightly coupled to the app's location permissions. Strong UX implication: the app becomes a kitchen trigger, not just an order tool.

Feature: Updated MyMcDonald's Rewards point redemption thresholds effective March 17 — new rewards catalog with revised point costs across menu items.
Source: McDonald's corporate newsroom; multiple press — effective March 17, 2026
Notes: Framed as 'fresh new rewards.' Part of broader push to reach 250M 90-day active loyalty users and $45B in systemwide loyalty sales by 2027.

Feature: Integrated Paze as a checkout payment option in the app with a promotional '$10 back on $10+ spend' incentive (up to 10x per card) running June 15 – September 10 2026.
Source: Wendys.com; Paze.com; Doctor of Credit; The Points Guy — live June 15, 2026
Notes: Paze is a bank-consortium digital wallet (Early Warning Services). Adding it alongside Google Pay / Apple Pay / cards. Promotion is time-limited but the payment method integration is permanent.

Feature: Rebuilt the app from the ground up with faster menu browsing and checkout; moved 'Favorites' and 'Past Orders' to a persistent one-tap menu bar item.
Source: Subway.com app changelog; SubwayMenuUS.com — effective April 1, 2026
Notes: Coincided with loyalty program relaunch. Persistent bottom-bar shortcuts reduce depth of navigation to reorder.

Feature: Replaced 'Sub Club' loyalty with a new program that removes the buy-3-get-1-free benefit and introduces member-only pricing with regularly rotating exclusive offers.
Source: Doctor of Credit; Loyalty & Reward Co; Subway.com — effective April 1, 2026
Notes: Earn rate stays the same but the high-value buy-3-get-1 perk is gone. Positioned as a move toward personalized offers. New users get 250 bonus points or a free cookie on sign-up.

Feature: Increased point values for some rewards starting April 4 and expanded menu item options available at each loyalty tier.
Notes: Direction is member-favorable (more value per point, more choice). No structural tier changes — existing four-tier system (Member / Silver / Red / Signature) unchanged.
